name: Qi Luo Di Yinluan Rensheng
source:
All the men in the world are the same creatures. They think they own me by covering my body and that I depend on them. It is the opposite.

I can either moan on the bed or whisper “I am only for you” into their ears to satisfy their needs. Yet it is just a game. It is a fair game in which I seek what I want from you by satisfying your desires. And I never thought it was wrong.

Bai Li, my only friend, who never could understand me, never left me.

In this world, she is the only one who treats me sincerely. Even though she often appears to be hesitant to say something.

When I successfully entered the government agencies, I got to know many celebrities in government and business and talented youth. After repeated exchange games for interests, I should be gradually approaching the life I want, but why do I now feel I’m more and more empty and that the world around me is becoming worse and worse?

This game of taking what I want is gradually losing control and the instinct to do whatever I want with my lustful life is starting to get out of control ......

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778290/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这世上的男人全都是一样的生物。他们以为只要压在我身上便算占有了我，以为我会就此依附于他们——殊不知恰恰相反。

我既可以在床上婉转呻吟，也可以在他们耳畔低语“我只属于你”，以此迎合他们的需求。可这终归只是一场游戏——一场通过满足你的欲望，来换取我想要之物的公平游戏。而我从不觉得这有什么错。

白梨是我唯一的朋友。她始终无法理解我的做法，却也从未离开过我。

在这个世界上，唯有她真心待我——尽管她面对我时常常一副欲言又止的模样。

顺利进入政府机关后，我结识了不少政商名流与青年才俊。在一场又一场利益交换的游戏之后，我本该离理想中的生活越来越近，可为什么如今内心却愈发空虚，周遭的世界也仿佛正变得越来越糟？

这场各取所需的游戏正在逐渐失控，而任凭本能在淫靡人生中肆意放纵的冲动，也开始一发不可收拾……
